understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate the grid to complete each level by stepping onto every goal cell only when the carried piece’s shape, color, and rotation exactly match that goal’s required attributes; after all goals in a level are completed, advance to the next level and ultimately finish all levels before running out of lives/turns.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move costs 1 stamina and movement is blocked by walls; attempting a blocked direction wastes the move and stamina while leaving you in place (so you must always avoid directions listed as blocked_directions). When stamina reaches 0, you lose 1 life and stamina resets to its maximum; losing all lives ends the game (GAME_OVER). Special modifier tiles change the carried piece: shape changers cycle shape 0–5 (wrapping), color changers cycle colors in order orange→blue→green→red→orange, and rotation changers rotate 90° clockwise (0→90→180→270→0). A goal activates and can be completed only if shape+color+rotation all match simultaneously when you step onto the goal cell; stamina refill tiles restore stamina.
